stories.title: C# solution builds with zero errors
stories.description: The entire HLVRCOOP.sln must compile without errors in Release configuration
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build HLVRCOOP.sln -c Release exits with code 0 and zero errors
Zero Error-level diagnostics from LSP on all modified .cs files
stories.evidence: Build succeeded with 0 errors, 9 warnings (pre-existing CS4014 + NETSDK1138). No LSP available but build is authoritative.

stories.title: Lua script has zero syntax/logic errors
stories.description: The hlvrcoop_interval.lua script must have zero detectable errors
acceptanceCriteria: All Convars:RegisterCommand callbacks have correct argument counts matching their C# callers
No nil-dereference paths remain in InterpolateEntity or any VConsole command handler
HLVRCOOP_FIRED_TRIGGERS keyed consistently (UUID in UUID mode) between fireit() and hlvrcoop_fireoutput
DMGE packet only sent when previous health is known (not nil)
All print() packet formats match Packet.cs ParseType expectations
stories.evidence: Line 852: target_pos nil guard added. Lines 546-555: firedKey uses UUID. Lines 268-274: prevHealth nil check. Protocol agent verified all packet format matches.

stories.title: C#-Lua protocol has zero format mismatches
stories.description: Every C# command string must exactly match what the corresponding Lua callback expects
acceptanceCriteria: All Lua->C# print() formats handled by ParseTrailingFields
stories.evidence: Protocol reviewer verified all 7 C#->Lua commands and all 14 Lua->C# packet types. Zero mismatches.

stories.title: Thread safety has zero deadlock or race conditions
stories.description: Lock ordering is consistent, no nested locks, and async lambdas capture value types
acceptanceCriteria: seqLock and sync are never held simultaneously
ClientOpen Task.Run captures Guid before delay
AlyxGlobalData.AddPlayer holds sync lock through entire operation
No concurrent List<> mutation without lock protection
stories.evidence: Thread safety reviewer verified all 4 claims with line-number evidence. Locks sequential (not nested), Guid captured at line 120, AddPlayer lock at line 258 covers through line 268, all players mutations inside lock(sync).
